business_summary.text: Alicon Castalloy is an auto components manufacturer specializing in casting and machining, serving automotive and industrial segments globally.

call_points.text: FY27 revenue growth guided at 8-10% YoY, excluding aluminum volatility
Order book at ₹7,600 Cr over 6 years; includes JLR program
FY27 EBITDA margins expected to expand by 1.5% to 12.5-13%
FY27 capex to be funded through internal accruals
Aluminum price volatility remains a key margin risk

timeline.summary: Alicon Castalloy held Q4FY26 earnings call on May 13, 2026, reporting highest ever quarterly revenue of ₹495 Cr and guiding FY27 revenue growth at 8-10%.

watchlist.response: Management expects no loss in gross profit due to pass-through pricing, but EBITDA margins may be pressured
New orders require significant investment in technology and automation, focusing on margin improvement rather than asset turnover
watchlist.text: Low asset turnover ratio despite high capex
